[Super, then I will also install it today.] Speaker B: Here is your shawarma. సర్, కింద ఉన్న ఇన్స్టాల్ బటన్ నొక్కి MySivi యాప్ ఇన్స్టాల్ చేసుకోండి. [Sir, click the install button below and install the MySivi app.]

summary: An impatient customer is surprised when a shawarma vendor responds in fluent English. The vendor explains he learned it using the MySivi app, which offers AI-driven English practice in Telugu for just 1 rupee. The customer is convinced to download the app.
